\operatorname{lcm}\{\hat d_r:m_r\in\mathbf{M}\}=\lambda,

$\mathbb P^{\operatorname{lcm}}_\lambda$ maximizes the period of every coefficient $\gamma_i$, for fixed $q$.

$$
f,f'\text{ are binary strings and }Q_d(f)\cong Q_d(f'),
$$

then

$$
Q_{d-1}(f)\cong Q_{d-1}(f').
$$

The conjecture is motivated by the paper's extremal isomorphism theorem, which gives explicit non-trivial isomorphisms in a range of dimensions; it asks whether every such isomorphism persists after reducing the dimension by one.

The conjecture proposes that the examples obtained in the paper exhaust all Ulrich partition types for two-step flag varieties. The paper gives partial classifications and states that the classification remains incomplete, so the conjecture is open.
